acceptance_results.evidence: The three named groups are now inside registered regions: mpd-delta scope-overlap (inScopeOverlap rewrite), mpd-delta scope-overlap-normalize (normalizeScopePattern), mpd-delta create-contract-gate (the create-time contradiction gate in validateCreateTask); all 9 regions and their spans are listed in f2/region-inventory.log. The new F2 test performs a real LCS line diff between the pre-delta revision (git HEAD) and the working tree and asserts that EVERY added line is inside a region, a marker line, or prose — zero executable lines outside a region (plus explicit assertions that the three named groups are inside). Raw log: f2/self-fix-suite.log. Two guard-side root causes found while closing F2 and fixed in the same pass: writeRegistry could pick an anchor living INSIDE another region (the old scope-glob anchor was pathMatchesScopeNormalized, declared by the neighbouring scope-glob-core region), so a dropped region took its own anchor with it and healed nothing — anchors are now selected outside every region span; and --write-registry no longer runs a same-process verification that could only ever see the pre-write registry.
